title: Optimally Fermented German White Cornmeal Bao
description: A plant-based German dish featuring fermented white cornmeal, perfect for post-workout meals, made with double-rise bread and steamed in a bamboo steamer. This recipe combines the benefits of fermentation and aerated dough for a unique taste experience.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the white cornmeal, all-purpose flour, yeast, salt, and sugar.
Gradually add the lukewarm water and plant-based milk, mixing until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and knead it for another 5 minutes.
Divide the dough into 6 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Place the balls into a bamboo steamer lined with parchment paper, leaving some space between each bao.
Steam the bao over boiling water for 15 minutes, or until they are cooked through and fluffy.
Brush the melted vegan butter on top of the bao and serve warm.
